_comment: AWGN-FP ROW 0c validity check -- level-dependence probe, -10 dB variant. Exact copy of ../../scenarios/s5-noise.json parts 0/1 with level_dbfs shifted by -10 dB (part 0: -20 -> -30, part 1: -10 -> -20). scenario id/part_index/trial_index are UNCHANGED so harness.common.compute_seed() derives the identical 60 seeds as ROW 0b's anchor -- same noise realisations, different amplitude scale only, per the spec's 'repeat 0b's 60 slots at the rendered level +/-10 dB' instruction. Not used for any live sweep; offline-render-only, part of qa/rr-study/2026-09-02-1906-architect-to-qa-spec-awgn-fp-offline-replay.md.
name: Noise / birdies (ROW 0c, -10 dB)
description: ROW 0c level-dependence probe: identical seeds to S5 parts 0/1, level_dbfs shifted -10 dB.
harness_note: No FT8 signal is synthesised. Each part renders a 15 s audio buffer containing only the specified interference. Any decode reported by either appraiser is a false positive.
